title: MT60004: Principles And Techniques Of Materials
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Optical Metallography techniques like polarized light microscopy, DIC,
fluorescence, etc.; Diffraction Methods like texture measurement, residual
stress analysis, EXAFS, neutron diffraction, etc.; Electron Optical and related
techniques like TEM, SEM, EDS, WDS/EPMA, CBED, HREM, EELS, etc.; Surface
Analysis and related techniques like Auger, XPS, SIMS, RBS, STM, AFM, etc.;
Thermal Analysis like DTA, DSC, TGA, TMA, etc.; Spectroscopy Techniques like
optical emission spectroscopy, atomic absorption spectrometry, x-ray
spectrometry, infrared spectroscopy, Raman spectroscopy, electron spin
resonance, nuclear magnetic resonance, Mossbauer spectroscopy, etc.; Electrical
Resistivity measurement
